ACT XI OF 2021
PUNJAB INFECTIOUS DISEASES (PREVENTION
AND CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2021
An Act to amend the Punjab
Infectious Diseases
(Prevention and Control) Act 2020
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
17th May, 2021]
No.
PAP/Legis-2(75)/2020/2534, dated 17.5.2021.---The Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control) (Amendment)
Bill 2020, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on May
04, 2021, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on May 11, 2021, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It
is necessary to amend the Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control)
Act 2020 (XIII of 2020) for its better implementation.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be cited as the Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control)
(Amendment) Act, 2021.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
2. Insertion
of section 28-A in Act XIII of 2020.---In the Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control) Act 2020
(XIII of 2020), after section 28, the following section 28-A shall be inserted:
"28-A.
Temporary regulations.---The Secretary may, by notification in the official
Gazette, frame such temporary regulations to be observed by a person or a class
of persons as may be necessary to prevent outbreak or spread of an infectious
disease, and the Secretary may determine in what manner and by whom any
expenses incurred due to such diseases shall be defrayed.".
